question: Should Microsoft Teams adopt `channels.msteams.accounts` and `channels.msteams.defaultAccount` as the supported long-term multi-bot configuration contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically strong, but merging creates a permanent public configuration, credential, authorization, and persisted-state contract that cannot be accepted by automated review alone.

options.title: Sponsor this account contract
options.body: Accept the proposed account model after the unrelated glossary change is removed and the exact head remains green.

options.title: Narrow or redesign first
options.body: Request a different or smaller account/config contract before accepting the implementation.

options.title: Decline multi-account support
options.body: Close the PR and retain one Microsoft Teams bot identity per gateway.

recommendation.title: Sponsor this account contract
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed account model after the unrelated glossary change is removed and the exact head remains green.

likelyOwner.reason: The broad recent merged history covers the central Teams runtime, setup, delivery, and plugin-contract surfaces affected by this decision.
